publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.26 reduces Cloudflare D1 usage for hosted monitoring on Workers Free. The minute cron reads current monitor evidence and caches scheduled schema checks. Dashboard and Prometheus reports use bounded availability buckets, and the console polls conditionally. Hosted checks retain full evidence, fold expired attempt windows through checkpoints, and batch pending availability records into buckets. In a simulated day with four one-minute hosted monitors, 30 days of retained history, an open console and Prometheus scraping every 15 seconds, the workload wrote 60,278 rows and read 940,073 rows, within the test budget of 1,000,000 reads. Nightly Verify uses the same eight rebalanced shards as push CI. Migrations 0090 through 0096 add partial indexes, availability and scrape tables, and hosted storage columns and views. They retain the existing slot projection index and avoid rewriting retained slot rows. The populated upgrade test wrote 352 D1 rows. If an unreleased build from main applied an earlier copy of migration 0090 or 0094, check its migration ledger before upgrading. The earlier hashes can cause the ledger to refuse the upgrade. Databases that applied 0094 from commit f4459193 can retain indexes that stop scheduled checks and alerts. All 91 SQL migrations from 0.5.25 are byte-identical. Existing monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are carried forward, with no new required settings. The @runeditrun/rer pin is 0.2.131. Before upgrading, use Settings > Backup and files > Download backup with a second factor verified within five minutes. Keep private settings and .rer/deploy separately, plus a hosted database backup if applicable. For a CLI backup, verify the native session while dev is running, stop dev, and use the verified UPTIME_ACCESS_COOKIE to run rer export --output exports/uptime.rer within five minutes. Keep the cookie private. Update with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. Stop dev or preview before deploying, keep the deployment receipt, and use the existing installation keys. The mail configuration guidance and known limits in the changelog still apply. Product screenshot available from 0.4.0 at .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png. — Run Edit Run fleet, 2026-11-23.
